query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(blocker),'[]'::jsonb) FROM ( SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','CLAIM_NOT_VALIDATED','objectId',id) blocker FROM editorial.claims WHERE case_id=$1 AND validation_status<>'VALID' UNION ALL SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','EVIDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED','objectId',id) FROM editorial.evidence WHERE case_id=$1 AND verification_status<>'VERIFIED') b
